//: 一種問題一列：分組、預設嚴重度、WCAG 準則、中英文的「是什麼／為什麼／怎麼修」。主控台、報告、rules 指令、SARIF 都從這裡來；README 與 docs 的表由測試核對。改字只改這裡。

groups.en: out of reach of the keyboard

en.title: Control has no accessible name
en.why: UI Automation has no name for this control, so all a screen reader can call it is "button" (or "check box", "tab"…).
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.Name, or AutomationProperties.LabeledBy to an element that has text. A ToolTip is not a name: WPF exposes it as the help text, which some screen readers read as a description after the type.

zh.title: 控制項沒有名稱
zh.why: 螢幕閱讀器只能念「按鈕」「核取方塊」，說不出是做什麼的。
zh.how: 設 AutomationProperties.Name，或用 AutomationProperties.LabeledBy 指到有文字的元素。ToolTip 不是名稱：WPF 把它當說明文字，有的螢幕閱讀器會念在型別後面。

en.title: Visible text is not the accessible name
en.why: The control shows text, but the text sits inside a panel, a Border or an AccessText, and WPF only takes the name from a string, a TextBlock or a ContentControl. The accessible name is empty; for a tab, a list item or a hyperlink it is a type name or a space.
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.Name to the same text.

zh.title: 畫面有字，卻沒進名稱
zh.why: 字放在面板、Border 或 AccessText 裡，WPF 只從字串、TextBlock、ContentControl 拿名稱，所以名稱是空的；頁籤、清單項目、超連結是型別名或一個空白。

en.title: Accessible name is not readable text
en.why: The accessible name is an icon-font character, white space, a type name such as System.Windows.Controls.TabItem, or geometry path data.

zh.title: 名稱念不出意思
zh.why: 名稱是圖示字型的字元、空白、型別名（System.Windows.Controls.TabItem）或圖形的路徑資料。

en.title: Input has no accessible name
en.why: A screen reader cannot say what this field is for. A TextBlock next to it is not a label, and <Label Target=…> only moves focus with the access key: WPF does not use it for the name.
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.LabeledBy to the label, or AutomationProperties.Name.

zh.title: 輸入框沒有名稱
zh.why: 螢幕閱讀器說不出這一格要填什麼。旁邊的 TextBlock 不算標籤；<Label Target=…> 只會用快速鍵移焦點，WPF 不拿它當名稱。
zh.how: 用 AutomationProperties.LabeledBy 指到標籤，或設 AutomationProperties.Name。

en.title: List, grid or tree has no accessible name
en.why: A screen reader announces this as just "list", "data grid" or "tree" when focus enters it, so two of them in one window sound the same. A GroupBox around it and a <Label Target=…> do not name it.
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.LabeledBy to the heading above it, or AutomationProperties.Name.

zh.title: 清單、表格或樹沒有名稱
zh.why: 焦點進去時螢幕閱讀器只念「清單」「資料格」「樹狀檢視」，同一個視窗有兩個就分不出來。外面的 GroupBox 與 <Label Target=…> 都不會給它名稱。
zh.how: 用 AutomationProperties.LabeledBy 指到上面的標題，或設 AutomationProperties.Name。

en.title: Progress bar, calendar, menu or tool bar has no accessible name
en.why: A screen reader announces this as just "progress bar" or "tool bar". A menu or tool bar is only an info: one main menu per window needs no name.
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.LabeledBy to the text next to it, or AutomationProperties.Name.

zh.title: 進度條、月曆、選單或工具列沒有名稱
zh.why: 螢幕閱讀器只念「進度列」「工具列」。選單與工具列只當 info：一個視窗一個主選單，不用名稱也分得出來。
zh.how: 用 AutomationProperties.LabeledBy 指到旁邊的文字，或設 AutomationProperties.Name。

en.title: List items are read as their type name
en.why: An item made from data is named by the object's ToString(), and a class without one gives MyApp.Models.Note for every item. DisplayMemberPath and ItemTemplate only change what is shown.
en.how: Override ToString() in the class, or add a Setter for AutomationProperties.Name to the style of the items (ItemContainerStyle, RowStyle for a DataGrid; add it to the one that is there, a second one replaces it).

zh.title: 清單的項目念成類別名
zh.why: 資料產生的項目，名稱是物件的 ToString()；沒覆寫的類別，每一項都念成 MyApp.Models.Note。DisplayMemberPath 與 ItemTemplate 只管畫面。
zh.how: 在類別裡覆寫 ToString()，或在項目的樣式（ItemContainerStyle，DataGrid 是 RowStyle）加一個 AutomationProperties.Name 的 Setter —— 已經有樣式就加進那一個，再寫一個會整個取代。

en.title: Tab stops here and a screen reader says nothing
en.why: The element takes keyboard focus but has no AutomationPeer, so it is not in the UI Automation tree; AutomationProperties.Name does not help.
en.how: When it only holds other controls, set Focusable="False" (IsTabStop="False" when your code focuses it). When it is a control of its own, override OnCreateAutomationPeer, or derive from a control that has a peer.

zh.title: Tab 停得到，螢幕閱讀器卻沒聲音
zh.why: 元素拿得到鍵盤焦點，但沒有 AutomationPeer，不在 UI Automation 的樹上；設 AutomationProperties.Name 也沒用。
zh.how: 只是放別的控制項的，設 Focusable="False"（程式會叫它拿焦點的用 IsTabStop="False"）；自己是一個控制項的，覆寫 OnCreateAutomationPeer，或改成繼承有 peer 的控制項。

en.title: Accessible name does not contain the visible text
en.why: People who control the computer by voice say what they see. The control shows one text and its accessible name is another, so it does not react; people who see the screen and hear a screen reader get two answers.
en.how: Make the name start with the visible text, and add what is missing after it ("Browse for the input folder"), or drop AutomationProperties.Name when the text already says it.

zh.title: 名稱沒有包含畫面上的字
zh.why: 用說的操作電腦的人照畫面念。畫面寫一句、名稱是另一句，念了沒反應；看得到畫面又聽螢幕閱讀器的人聽到的是另一件事。
zh.how: 名稱以畫面上的字開頭，要補充的接在後面（「瀏覽輸入資料夾」）；畫面的字已經夠清楚，就不用另外寫 AutomationProperties.Name。

en.title: Accessible name is only a symbol
en.why: The accessible name is only punctuation or an emoji, and a screen reader reads the symbol's own name ("times" for ×).
en.how: Set AutomationProperties.Name to what the control does.

zh.title: 名稱只有符號
zh.why: 名稱只有標點或表情符號，螢幕閱讀器念的是符號自己的名字（× 念「乘以」）。
zh.how: 把 AutomationProperties.Name 設成它做的事。

en.title: Controls side by side may sound alike
en.why: They have the same accessible name and do different things. Fine when something that is announced tells them apart (a group, a label).
en.how: Otherwise add what each one is for to AutomationProperties.Name ("Browse for the input folder").

zh.title: 並排的控制項念起來可能一樣
zh.why: 名稱一樣、做的事不一樣。會念出來的東西（群組、標籤）分得出來就沒關係。
zh.how: 分不出來的話，在 AutomationProperties.Name 補上各自是做什麼的（「瀏覽輸入資料夾」）。

en.title: Works with the mouse but not the keyboard
en.why: An element that is not a control handles mouse clicks, and the keyboard has no way to do the same.
en.how: Use a Button (restyle it if needed): making a Border focusable fixes Tab, but a Border is never in the UI Automation tree.

zh.title: 滑鼠能用，鍵盤不能
zh.why: 不是控制項的元素處理了滑鼠點按，鍵盤沒有辦法做同一件事。
zh.how: 改用 Button（要的話換外觀）。只讓 Border 能聚焦不夠：Border 永遠不在 UI Automation 的樹上。

en.title: Interactive control is not in the tab order
en.why: IsTabStop="False" or Focusable="False" keeps Tab from reaching this control.
en.how: Fine when the same action has a keyboard shortcut or another focusable entry point; otherwise put it back.

zh.title: Tab 到不了
zh.why: IsTabStop="False" 或 Focusable="False" 讓 Tab 跳過它。
zh.how: 同一件事有快速鍵或別的入口就沒關係，沒有的話把它放回 Tab 順序。

en.title: Keyboard focus is not visible
en.why: FocusVisualStyle is removed and nothing else shows focus: the template and styles have no IsKeyboardFocused or IsFocused trigger and no Focused visual state.
en.how: Keep the default FocusVisualStyle, or draw focus in the template.

zh.title: 看不到鍵盤焦點在哪
zh.why: FocusVisualStyle 被拿掉，範本與樣式裡也沒有別的東西表示焦點（沒有 IsKeyboardFocused、IsFocused 觸發器，也沒有 Focused 狀態）。
zh.how: 留著預設的 FocusVisualStyle，或在範本裡畫出焦點。

en.title: Click target is smaller than 24 by 24
en.why: The target's size is set to less than 24 DIP and it is too close to its neighbour for the spacing exception of WCAG 2.5.8.
en.how: Make it 24 by 24, or leave more room around it.

zh.title: 點擊範圍小於 24 × 24
zh.why: 大小設得比 24 DIP 小，而且離隔壁太近，用不了 WCAG 2.5.8 的間距例外。
